item.title: Michigan Chronicle, 1 of 28 Black and Brown Publishers Selected to Participate in the Google News Initiative Ad Transformation Lab
item.description: Washington, DC, January 14, 2021: The Google News Initiative, in partnership with the Association of Alternative Newsmedia (AAN), the National Association of Hispanic Publications (NAHP), and the National Newspaper Publishers Association (NNPA), today kicked off the GNI Ad Transformation Lab: a six month program to help Black and Latino news publishers in the U.S. and Canada advance their advertising strategies and grow digital revenue.
